shortDescription: Manage quota tree on the Unity storage system

options.name: cap_unit
options.description: Unit of I(soft_limit) and I(hard_limit) size. It defaults to C(GB) if not specified.

options.name: filesystem_id
options.description: The ID of the filesystem for which the quota tree is created. For creation of a quota tree either I(filesystem_id) or I(filesystem_name) is required.

options.name: filesystem_name
options.description: The name of the filesystem for which quota tree is created. For creation or modification of a quota tree either I(filesystem_name) or I(filesystem_id) is required.

options.name: hard_limit
options.description: Hard limitation for a quota tree on the total space available. If exceeded, users in quota tree cannot write data. Value C(0) implies no limit. One of the values of I(soft_limit) and I(hard_limit) can be C(0), however, both cannot be both C(0) during creation of a quota tree.

options.name: nas_server_id
options.description: The ID of the NAS server in which the filesystem is created. For creation of a quota tree either I(filesystem_id) or I(filesystem_name) is required.

options.name: nas_server_name
options.description: The name of the NAS server in which the filesystem is created. For creation of a quota tree either I(nas_server_name) or I(nas_server_id) is required.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unity management server.

options.name: path
options.description: The path to the quota tree. Either I(tree_quota_id) or I(path) to quota tree is required to create/view/modify/delete a quota tree. Path must start with a forward slash '/'.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with Unity management server.

options.name: soft_limit
options.description: Soft limitation for a quota tree on the total space available. If exceeded, notification will be sent to users in the quota tree for the grace period mentioned, beyond which users cannot use space. Value C(0) implies no limit. Both I(soft_limit) and I(hard_limit) cannot be C(0) during creation of quota tree.

options.name: state
options.description: The state option is used to mention the existence of the filesystem quota tree.

options.name: tree_quota_id
options.description: The ID of the quota tree. Either I(tree_quota_id) or I(path) to quota tree is required to view/modify/delete quota tree.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unity management server.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the Unity management server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
